Type of Test Required *

Please select one test type

Developmental Assistance: The customer has the flexibility to carry out customized tests for debugging purposes and try out design changes to the product to fix issues if any. No formal test report will be issued from the lab. Test data and graphs will be provided to the customer (Note: Formal test report will not be issued).
Pre-Compliance Test: Testing will be carried out by the lab as mandated in the standards without any debugging or changes to the product during the test. This is a Pass/Fail objective test. A test report will be issued without NABL logo from the lab at the completion of the tests. The details mentioned in this questionnaire will reflect in the test report. Later the lab will not accept any change requests to be made in the test reports owing to incorrect/insufficient information provided in the questionnaire.
Compliance Test: Testing will be carried out by the lab as mandated in the standards without any debugging or changes to the product during the test. This is a Pass/Fail objective test. A formal NABL test report will be issued from the lab at the completion of the tests. The details mentioned in this questionnaire will reflect in the test report. Later the lab will not accept any change requests to be made in the test reports owing to incorrect/insufficient information provided in the questionnaire.

Group *

Group 1 equipment:
group 1 contains all equipment in the scope of this document which is not classified as group 2 equipment.
Group 2 equipment:
